title: "CMS Start cutover packet"
description: "Source and operator checklist for a future CMS Worker cutover."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

CMS has a TanStack Start/Void candidate. Production publication and routing are
held; this packet records the source target and checks required before Rex
authorizes a cutover. It does not authorize deployment, provider changes or data
writes.

## Worker and configuration

- Worker: `tuturuuu-cms` for production; the staging Worker name for
  staging.
- Hosts: `cms.tuturuuu.com` and the `/cms` mount on `tuturuuu.com`. The
  configuration rejects unknown hosts and disables Workers.dev and preview
  URLs.
- Build: `cd apps/cms && bun run build:cloudflare`.
- Static asset binding: `ASSETS`. Optional internal API origin variable:
  `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN`. The build profile sets `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX`.
- Runtime secret names required by CMS: `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`,
  `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` is a non-secret environment binding. Set secret
  values only in the protected runtime secret store; this page records names
  only.

## Smoke checks

After an authorized cutover, probe public deployment identity at both mounts and
verify the native runtime header and expected source SHA:

```sh
curl -fsS -D - https://cms.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
curl -fsSI https://tuturuuu.com/cms/api/build-info
```

Run the existing isolated emitted-worker and cutover smoke checks before
publication:

```sh
(cd apps/cms && CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" bun run test:runtime)
node scripts/ci/cms-cutover-smoke.mjs
```

Confirm anonymous `/` redirects to `/login`, unknown hosts are rejected, and
the root and mounted build-info requests return the deployed identity.

## Rollback

Before routing changes, Rex records the immutable Vercel deployment ID and the
exact routes, custom domains and DNS records being replaced, plus the one-step
restore command and rollback owner. No deployment ID is recorded in this
repository, so Rex must capture it. Restore that routing to the prior deployment
immediately if smoke or the post-cutover watch regresses. Keep the deployment
available for the full release cycle.
